title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – A and B Mechanical, Inc. – Sequoia Elementary School Boiler Replacement Project - Department of Buildings and Grounds
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Bid Award, rejecting all other bids, and an Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and A and B Mechanical, Inc., Livermore, CA, for the latter to remove existing steam boiler and install new cast iron sectional steam boiler, with work including demolition of the existing boiler and associated piping, hazmat abatement as needed, rigging and installation of the new boiler, reconnection to existing steam, gas, and electrical services, adaptation of the existing flue system, and full commissioning to confirm proper operation of the new equipment for the Sequoia Elementary School Boiler Replacement Project, in the amount of $160,611.00, as the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, which includes a contingency of $13,500.00 with the work anticipated to commence on October 15, 2026, and required to be completed within sixty (60) days, with an anticipated ending of  November 15, 2026.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Awards $160,611 contract to A and B Mechanical to replace the boiler at Sequoia Elementary
summary: A and B Mechanical, Inc. of Livermore will remove the old steam boiler at Sequoia Elementary School and install a new one. The work includes demolition, hazardous-materials cleanup as needed, reconnecting steam, gas and electrical lines, and testing the new equipment. The company was the lowest qualified bidder, and the $160,611 includes a $13,500 contingency, with work expected to run from October 15 to November 15, 2026.
source_issue: The text requires completion within sixty days of an October 15, 2026 start, but states an anticipated end date of November 15, 2026, which is about thirty days after the start.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
